<OPTIONS>
/NODE=KM.ARIES
/UN=//
/PW=
/OLEDB=SQLPlus
/ENGINE=VA
/WORKDIR=.\
/T=
/CSV=yeuchuan_a0_8852.tab
/CTROW=lot,operation,test_end_date,tester_id,program_name,ws_loss_code,complevel_1,complevel_2,tray_or_carrier_id,lane_number,carrier_x,carrier_y,visual_id
/CTVALUE=all_value
/CTHEADER=test_name
/CTARRAY=a0,8852
/HEADERS=lot,operation,test_end_date,tester_id,program_name,ws_loss_code,complevel_1,complevel_2,test_name,tray_or_carrier_id,lane_number,carrier_x,carrier_y,visual_id,all_value
/INSTANCE=8852
/PROMPT-TEXT=Step 1.1-a0. Fetching ARIES Data
/RECORD=AT_Metrology@1.0.0.0
/HADOOP_SERVER_DEFAULT=ATD_ATM.HADOOP
</OPTIONS>

/*BEGIN SQL*/
SELECT 
          lot AS lot
         ,operation AS operation
         ,To_Char(test_end_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS test_end_date
         ,tester_id AS tester_id
         ,program_name AS program_name
         ,ws_loss_code AS ws_loss_code
         ,complevel_1 AS complevel_1
         ,complevel_2 AS complevel_2
         ,test_name AS test_name
         ,tray_or_carrier_id AS tray_or_carrier_id
         ,lane_number AS lane_number
         ,carrier_x AS carrier_x
         ,carrier_y AS carrier_y
         ,visual_id AS visual_id
         ,Max(all_value) AS all_value
FROM
(
SELECT  
          ats.lot AS lot
         ,ats.operation AS operation
         ,ats.test_end_date_time AS test_end_date
         ,ats.tester_id AS tester_id
         ,ats.program_name AS program_name
         ,dt.ws_loss_code AS ws_loss_code
         ,ctr.complevel_1 AS complevel_1
         ,ctr.complevel_2 AS complevel_2
         ,t.test_name AS test_name
         ,dt.testing_session_tray_id AS tray_or_carrier_id
         ,dt.lane_number AS lane_number
         ,dt.carrier_x AS carrier_x
         ,dt.carrier_y AS carrier_y
         ,di.visual_id AS visual_id
         ,CASE WHEN ctr.string_value IS NULL THEN to_char(ctr.numeric_result) ELSE ctr.string_value END AS all_value
FROM 
A_Testing_Session ats
INNER JOIN A_All_Component_Testing_Result ctr ON ctr.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = ats.ts_id AND (ctr.numeric_result IS NOT NULL or ctr.string_value is NOT NULL)
INNER JOIN A_Test t ON t.t_id = ctr.t_id
INNER JOIN A_Device_Testing dt ON dt.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND dt.ts_id = ats.ts_id
AND dt.lao_start_ww = ctr.lao_start_ww AND dt.ts_id = ctr.ts_id AND dt.dt_id = ctr.dt_id
LEFT JOIN A_Device_Item di ON di.di_id = dt.di_id
WHERE ats.data_domain='METROLOGY'
 AND      ats.lot In ('7548G088') 
 AND      ats.operation In ('2090'
,'1960') 
 AND      (ats.tester_id LIKE  'IIS%'
) 
 AND      (ctr.complevel_1 LIKE  '%SEALANT%'
) 
 AND      ctr.complevel_2 = 'INSPRES' 
 AND      t.test_name In ('QUALITY1'
,'QUALITY2'
,'POSX'
,'POSY'
,'AREA'
,'ANGLE'
,'PROCESSTIMESTAMP') 
)
GROUP BY 
          lot
         ,operation
         ,test_end_date
         ,tester_id
         ,program_name
         ,ws_loss_code
         ,complevel_1
         ,complevel_2
         ,test_name
         ,tray_or_carrier_id
         ,lane_number
         ,carrier_x
         ,carrier_y
         ,visual_id
/*END SQL*/

<OPTIONS>

/CTVALUE=all_value_2
/CTHEADER=test_name_2
/CTARRAY=a8,8852
/HEADERS=lot_8,operation_8,test_name_2,complevel_1_5,all_value_2,visual_id_8,tester_id_2,complevel_2_2
/INSTANCE=8852
/PROMPT-TEXT=Step 1.1-a8. Fetching ARIES Data
/RECORD=AT_Metrology@1.0.0.0
/HADOOP_SERVER_DEFAULT=ATD_ATM.HADOOP
</OPTIONS>

/*BEGIN SQL*/
SELECT  DISTINCT 
          lot_8 AS lot_8
         ,operation_8 AS operation_8
         ,test_name_2 AS test_name_2
         ,complevel_1_5 AS complevel_1_5
         ,Max(all_value_2) AS all_value_2
         ,visual_id_8 AS visual_id_8
         ,tester_id_2 AS tester_id_2
         ,complevel_2_2 AS complevel_2_2
FROM
(
SELECT  
          ats.lot AS lot_8
         ,ats.operation AS operation_8
         ,t.test_name AS test_name_2
         ,ctr.complevel_1 AS complevel_1_5
         ,CASE WHEN ctr.string_value IS NULL THEN to_char(ctr.numeric_result) ELSE ctr.string_value END AS all_value_2
         ,di.visual_id AS visual_id_8
         ,ats.tester_id AS tester_id_2
         ,ctr.complevel_2 AS complevel_2_2
FROM 
A_Testing_Session ats
INNER JOIN A_All_Component_Testing_Result ctr ON ctr.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = ats.ts_id AND (ctr.numeric_result IS NOT NULL or ctr.string_value is NOT NULL)
INNER JOIN A_Test t ON t.t_id = ctr.t_id
INNER JOIN A_Device_Testing dt ON dt.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND dt.ts_id = ats.ts_id
AND dt.lao_start_ww = ctr.lao_start_ww AND dt.ts_id = ctr.ts_id AND dt.dt_id = ctr.dt_id
LEFT JOIN A_Device_Item di ON di.di_id = dt.di_id
WHERE ats.data_domain='METROLOGY'
 AND      (ats.lot In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a0_8852.tab", lot, "ats.lot In") 
 AND      ats.operation In ('1960'
,'2090') 
 AND      ctr.complevel_1 Like '%STIM-VI%' 
 AND      t.test_name In ('POSX'
,'POSY'
,'QUALITY1'
,'QUALITY2'
,'PROCESSTIMESTAMP') 
 AND      ctr.complevel_2 = 'INSPRES' 
)
GROUP BY 
          lot_8
         ,operation_8
         ,test_name_2
         ,complevel_1_5
         ,visual_id_8
         ,tester_id_2
         ,complevel_2_2
/*END SQL*/

/CTHEADER=test_name_1

/INSTANCE=8852

/RECORD=AT_Metrology@1.0.0.0

/*BEGIN SQL*/
SELECT  DISTINCT 
          lot_2 AS lot_2
         ,operation_2 AS operation_2
         ,tester_id_1 AS tester_id_1
         ,complevel_1_1 AS complevel_1_1
         ,visual_id_2 AS visual_id_2
         ,test_name_1 AS test_name_1
         ,Max(all_value_1) AS all_value_1
FROM
(
SELECT /*+  ordered */ 
          ats.lot AS lot_2
         ,ats.operation AS operation_2
         ,ats.tester_id AS tester_id_1
         ,ctr.complevel_1 AS complevel_1_1
         ,di.visual_id AS visual_id_2
         ,t.test_name AS test_name_1
         ,CASE WHEN ctr.string_value IS NULL THEN to_char(ctr.numeric_result) ELSE ctr.string_value END AS all_value_1
FROM 
A_Device_Item di
INNER JOIN A_Device_Testing dt ON dt.di_id = di.di_id
INNER JOIN A_Testing_Session ats ON ats.lao_start_ww = dt.lao_start_ww AND ats.ts_id = dt.ts_id AND ats.data_domain='METROLOGY'
INNER JOIN A_All_Component_Testing_Result ctr ON ctr.lao_start_ww = dt.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = dt.ts_id AND ctr.dt_id = dt.dt_id AND (ctr.numeric_result IS NOT NULL or ctr.string_value is NOT NULL)
AND ctr.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = ats.ts_id
INNER JOIN A_Test t ON t.t_id = ctr.t_id
WHERE 1=1
 AND      (ats.lot In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a0_8852.tab", lot, "ats.lot In") 
 AND      ats.operation In ('1960'
,'2090') 
 AND      (di.visual_id In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a0_8852.tab", visual_id, "di.visual_id In") 
 AND      t.test_name = 'BINCODE' 
 AND      ats.tester_id Like 'IIS%' 
)
GROUP BY 
          lot_2
         ,operation_2
         ,tester_id_1
         ,complevel_1_1
         ,visual_id_2
         ,test_name_1
/*END SQL*/


<---- New Query ---->

<OPTIONS>
/NODE=KM.ARIES
/UN=//
/PW=
/OLEDB=SQLPlus
/ENGINE=VA
/WORKDIR=.\
/T=
/CSV=yeuchuan_a1_8852.tab
/CTROW=lot_1,operation_1,processing_end_date,media_id,lane_name,bonding_station,visual_id_1,bin_code,media_in_x,media_in_y
/CTVALUE=numeric_value_md
/CTHEADER=parameter_name_md
/CTARRAY=a1,8852
/HEADERS=lot_1,operation_1,processing_end_date,media_id,lane_name,bonding_station,parameter_name_md,numeric_value_md,visual_id_1,bin_code,media_in_x,media_in_y
/INSTANCE=8852
/PROMPT-TEXT=Step 1.1-a1. Fetching ARIES Data
/RECORD=AT_TDX_DIA@1.0.0.0
/HADOOP_SERVER_DEFAULT=ATD_ATM.HADOOP
</OPTIONS>

/*BEGIN SQL*/
SELECT  DISTINCT 
          lot_1 AS lot_1
         ,operation_1 AS operation_1
         ,To_Char(processing_end_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS processing_end_date
         ,media_id AS media_id
         ,lane_name AS lane_name
         ,bonding_station AS bonding_station
         ,parameter_name_md AS parameter_name_md
         ,Max(numeric_value_md) AS numeric_value_md
         ,visual_id_1 AS visual_id_1
         ,bin_code AS bin_code
         ,media_in_x AS media_in_x
         ,media_in_y AS media_in_y
FROM
(
SELECT  
          z0.lot AS lot_1
         ,z0.operation AS operation_1
         ,z0.processing_end_time AS processing_end_date
         ,z2.media_id AS media_id
         ,z2.lane_name AS lane_name
         ,z2.bonding_station AS bonding_station
         ,z1.parameter_name AS parameter_name_md
         ,z1.numeric_value AS numeric_value_md
         ,z8.visual_id AS visual_id_1
         ,z8.bin_code AS bin_code
         ,z8.media_in_x AS media_in_x
         ,z8.media_in_y AS media_in_y
FROM 
ARIES_Views.AV_dia_session z0
LEFT JOIN ARIES_Views.AV_dia_media_testing z2 ON z2.lao_start_ww = z0.lao_start_ww AND z2.obj_s_id = z0.obj_s_id
LEFT JOIN ARIES_Views.AV_dia_media_data z1 ON z1.lao_start_ww = z2.lao_start_ww AND z1.obj_s_id = z2.obj_s_id AND z1.obj_mt_id = z2.obj_mt_id
INNER JOIN ARIES_Views.AV_dia_Unit_Testing z8 ON z8.lao_start_ww = z2.lao_start_ww AND z8.obj_s_id = z2.obj_s_id AND z8.obj_mt_id = z2.obj_mt_id
WHERE
              (z0.lot In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a2_8852.tab", lot_2, "z0.lot In") 
 AND      z0.operation In ('1960'
,'2090') 
 AND      (z8.visual_id In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a2_8852.tab", visual_id_2, "z8.visual_id In") 
 AND      z1.parameter_name In ('FINALSITTIME'
,'MAXFORCE'
,'MINFORCE'
,'MINPEDESTALTEMPERATURE'
,'OVERRULEDSITTIMEVIOLATION'
,'PEDESTALVACUUMVALUE'
,'MAXPEDESTALTEMPERATURE'
,'PROCESSTIMESTAMP') 
)
GROUP BY 
          lot_1
         ,operation_1
         ,processing_end_date
         ,media_id
         ,lane_name
         ,bonding_station
         ,parameter_name_md
         ,visual_id_1
         ,bin_code
         ,media_in_x
         ,media_in_y
/*END SQL*/

SELECT  DISTINCT 
          lot_3 AS lot_3
         ,operation_3 AS operation_3
         ,tester_id_3 AS tester_id_3
         ,program_name_2 AS program_name_2
         ,test_name_3 AS test_name_3
         ,complevel_2_1 AS complevel_2_1
         ,complevel_1_2 AS complevel_1_2
         ,Max(all_value_3) AS all_value_3
         ,visual_id_3 AS visual_id_3
         ,ws_loss_code_2 AS ws_loss_code_2
FROM
(
SELECT /*+  ordered */ 
          ats.lot AS lot_3
         ,ats.operation AS operation_3
         ,ats.tester_id AS tester_id_3
         ,ats.program_name AS program_name_2
         ,t.test_name AS test_name_3
         ,ctr.complevel_2 AS complevel_2_1
         ,ctr.complevel_1 AS complevel_1_2
         ,CASE WHEN ctr.string_value IS NULL THEN to_char(ctr.numeric_result) ELSE ctr.string_value END AS all_value_3
         ,di.visual_id AS visual_id_3
         ,dt.ws_loss_code AS ws_loss_code_2
FROM 
A_Device_Item di
INNER JOIN A_Device_Testing dt ON dt.di_id = di.di_id
INNER JOIN A_Testing_Session ats ON ats.lao_start_ww = dt.lao_start_ww AND ats.ts_id = dt.ts_id AND ats.data_domain='METROLOGY'
INNER JOIN A_All_Component_Testing_Result ctr ON ctr.lao_start_ww = dt.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = dt.ts_id AND ctr.dt_id = dt.dt_id AND (ctr.numeric_result IS NOT NULL or ctr.string_value is NOT NULL)
AND ctr.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = ats.ts_id
INNER JOIN A_Test t ON t.t_id = ctr.t_id
WHERE 1=1
 AND      (ats.lot In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a1_8852.tab", lot_1, "ats.lot In") 
 AND      ats.operation In ('2090'
,'1960') 
 AND      (di.visual_id In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a1_8852.tab", visual_id_1, "di.visual_id In") 
 AND      ats.tester_id Like 'OIS%' 
 AND      ctr.complevel_2 = 'INSPRES' 
 AND      ctr.complevel_1 Like '%LIDPOS%' 
 AND      t.test_name In ('ANGLE'
,'POSX'
,'POSY'
,'PROCESSTIMESTAMP') 
)
GROUP BY 
          lot_3
         ,operation_3
         ,tester_id_3
         ,program_name_2
         ,test_name_3
         ,complevel_2_1
         ,complevel_1_2
         ,visual_id_3
         ,ws_loss_code_2
/*END SQL*/

/CTHEADER=test_name_5
/CTARRAY=a5,8852
/HEADERS=lot_5,operation_5,tester_id_5,test_name_5,complevel_1_4,all_value_5,ws_loss_code_1,visual_id_5
/INSTANCE=8852
/PROMPT-TEXT=Step 1.1-a5. Fetching ARIES Data
/RECORD=AT_Metrology@1.0.0.0
/HADOOP_SERVER_DEFAULT=ATD_ATM.HADOOP
</OPTIONS>

/*BEGIN SQL*/
SELECT  DISTINCT 
          lot_5 AS lot_5
         ,operation_5 AS operation_5
         ,tester_id_5 AS tester_id_5
         ,test_name_5 AS test_name_5
         ,complevel_1_4 AS complevel_1_4
         ,Max(all_value_5) AS all_value_5
         ,ws_loss_code_1 AS ws_loss_code_1
         ,visual_id_5 AS visual_id_5
FROM
(
SELECT /*+  ordered */ 
          ats.lot AS lot_5
         ,ats.operation AS operation_5
         ,ats.tester_id AS tester_id_5
         ,t.test_name AS test_name_5
         ,ctr.complevel_1 AS complevel_1_4
         ,CASE WHEN ctr.string_value IS NULL THEN to_char(ctr.numeric_result) ELSE ctr.string_value END AS all_value_5
         ,dt.ws_loss_code AS ws_loss_code_1
         ,di.visual_id AS visual_id_5
FROM 
A_Device_Item di
INNER JOIN A_Device_Testing dt ON dt.di_id = di.di_id
INNER JOIN A_Testing_Session ats ON ats.lao_start_ww = dt.lao_start_ww AND ats.ts_id = dt.ts_id AND ats.data_domain='METROLOGY'
INNER JOIN A_All_Component_Testing_Result ctr ON ctr.lao_start_ww = dt.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = dt.ts_id AND ctr.dt_id = dt.dt_id AND (ctr.numeric_result IS NOT NULL or ctr.string_value is NOT NULL)
AND ctr.lao_start_ww = ats.lao_start_ww AND ctr.ts_id = ats.ts_id
INNER JOIN A_Test t ON t.t_id = ctr.t_id
WHERE 1=1
 AND      (ats.lot In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a4_8852.tab", lot_4, "ats.lot In") 
 AND      ats.operation In ('2090'
,'1960') 
 AND      ats.tester_id Like 'OIS%' 
 AND      t.test_name = 'BINCODE' 
 AND      (di.visual_id In 
SQL_Get_CSV_List(".\yeuchuan_a4_8852.tab", visual_id_4, "di.visual_id In") 
)
GROUP BY 
          lot_5
         ,operation_5
         ,tester_id_5
         ,test_name_5
         ,complevel_1_4
         ,ws_loss_code_1
         ,visual_id_5
/*END SQL*/
